title: Shim: Collision-Checked MCP Client Namespacing, Parallel Local Endpoint Discovery & Env-Ref Config
summary: Shim's mcp.Manager handles both HTTP and stdio MCP servers using MCP protocol version 2025-03-26 with 30s initialize/list timeouts and 60s tool call timeouts, emitting notifications/initialized before registering tools. Registered tool names are normalized as mcp_<server>_<tool> restricted to [A-Za-z0-9_-], truncated to 64 characters, and rejected on sanitized collision. Parallel provider discovery probes local endpoints (ollama /api/tags, lmstudio /models, llamacpp /models) under a 900ms budget, while internal/config/config.go persists CurrentVersion=1 settings atomically via os.CreateTemp inside 0o700 directories using api_key_env variable names instead of raw API secrets.
